name: Test Desktop
summary: Development fixture exercising the optional fields: platforms, license, variants, links and articles. It verifies that optional sections appear when present without disturbing the layout.

content.introduction: A development fixture used as both a component target for test-linux and as the resource that exercises every optional schema field.
content.what_is_it: A fictional desktop environment shipped in several editions.

variants.name: Test Desktop Standard
